findings.message: aharniśam is attached to tanotu (p2) as a kriyā-viśeṣaṇa. vyakhya-sts-14 instead ties it to vinodinīm: its anvaya puts 'अह:निशं विनोदिनीं मनोमुदं' together, and its bhāvārtha reads 'निशि-दिवस हमें प्रसन्न रखने वाली', i.e. 'delighting day and night'. Both attachments are grammatical, but the data does not record the other one as an alternative. A human should decide.
findings.suggested_fix: Either keep head p2 and add a note or alternative that vyakhya.org attaches aharniśam to vinodinīm (head p5), or change the head to p5.
